sources.snippet: Whisper-Large-V3-Turbo Transformer‑based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for multilingual transcription and translation available on HuggingFace. Whisper large‑v3‑turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large‑v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4. sources.title: Whisper Large v3 (Streaming) - Together AI
sources.snippet: About model Whisper Large v3 enables realtime voice agent applications with WebSocket streaming transcription on Together AI. Purpose-built infrastructure combines OpenAI's 1.55B parameter model with intelligent voice activity detection and turn detection, delivering complete transcripts 1.4 seconds faster than alternatives.
